title: Cobblemon Interface
description: Cobblemon inspired GUI Textures and Sounds
author: VinnyStalck
body:
Makes Minecraft's interface and sounds fit the [Cobblemon](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobblemon) mod aesthetics.

### Mod Support

| Mod | Cobblemon Interface |
|----:|:--------------------|
| [Cobblemon](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobblemon) | >= v1.1 |
| [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) | >= v0.7 |
| [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) | >= v0.1 |
| [Raised](https://modrinth.com/mod/raised) | >= v1.5.1 |

### Recommendations

[![](/launcher-preview/bodies/gfiYlQU0/0.webp)](https://modrinth.com/mod/respackopts)

⭐️: Highly Recommended |
📁: Resourcepack |
🛠️: Mod

- 🛠️⭐️ **[Respackopts](https://modrinth.com/mod/respackopts)**: Allows you to customize various aspects of the resourcepack in-game.
- 📁⭐️ **[Cobblemon Interface: Modded](https://modrinth.com/project/cobblemon-interface-modded)**: Adds support for many mods;
- 🛠️ **[Raised](https://modrinth.com/mod/raised)**: Moves the hotbar so it doesn't crop the texture;
- 📁 **[Fancy Item Renders](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fancy-item-renders)**: Tilts item displays so that items that have long textures (swords for example) doesn't look off with the rounded item slots.

### Minecraft Pack Version Compatibility
[Minecraft pack format](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Pack_format)

| Minecraft Pack | Minecraft | Cobblemon Interface |
|---------------:|:---------:|:--------------------|
| 9              | <= 1.19.2 | <= v0.7             |
| 15             | >= 1.20   | >= v0.8             |
| 34             | >= 1.21   | >= v1.4             |


## Credits

Texture based on [Torrezx-Improved Library](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/torrezx-improved-library) resourcepack books and inspired by the books in [Legends of Arceus trailer](https://youtu.be/SbIA8FKhwl0) intro books

## More

[Gitlab](https://gitlab.com/VinnyStalck/cobblemon-interface)

👆 You need to be in the [Official Cobblemon Discord Server🔗](https://discord.gg/cobblemon).

versions.name: 1.5.0 - Respackopts
versions.changelog:
### Added

- Be able to remove the custom Cobblemon panorama with Respackopts in the *Panorama* option.
- Merged Recolored addon resourcepack into Cobblemon Interface. Can be enabled with Respackopts in the *HUD Sprite Color* option.
- Merged UI Sound Boost addon resourcepack into Cobblemon Interface. Can be enabled with Respackopts in the *Boost Click Sound* option.

### Changed

- Modified `pack.mcmeta` description colors.
- Now uses [Respackopts](https://modrinth.com/mod/respackopts) for configuration.

versions.name: v1.0.0 - Release
b0.9.1 - Bit More Compatibilities
versions.changelog:
Added compatibility to a few other mods.

**Additions:**
- Support for [Simple Voice Chat](https://modrinth.com/plugin/simple-voice-chat), [Tom's Simple Storage](https://modrinth.com/mod/toms-storage), [Waystones](https://modrinth.com/mod/waystones) and [Zenith](https://modrinth.com/mod/zenith) mods. By: `@torchthedragon` on Discord.

**Fixes**
- Added missing sophisticated core mod scroll bar texture.

**Fixes:**
- Overfowing Bars' half toughtness bar icon beeing on the wrong side.
